name: zlib compress2
description: This logic group encompasses the compress2 high-level API and its underlying compression engine. compress2 is a simplified interface that manages the z_stream state to perform DEFLATE compression with a user-specified compression level. The core of this feature lies in the deflate function and its various strategy-specific implementations like deflate_fast and deflate_slow. These internal functions perform the actual work of pattern matching (using longest_match), sliding window management (via fill_window), and block-level compression.
